scope: Module fixed QName identity for variable, param and with-param declarations under local earlier versions; retained function parameter keyword metadata.
architecture: UsesModuleFixedVariableNamespaces limits the binding change to xsl:variable/param/with-param. Shared QName validation accepts an internal explicit namespace map. Registration/execution use the module map; authoring declaration diagnostics and scope use retained maps; captured keyword parameter names use retained declaration bindings independently of local grammar.
behavior: Fixed-only prefixes, native rebinding, aliases, no-namespace/EQName identities, global/local defaults, named-template/apply-templates/tunnel parameter passing, linked modules, namespace documents, keyword parameter metadata and expression edits are verified. Unused omitted-prefix names retain XTSE0280, malformed names XTSE0020, duplicate supplied identities XTSE0670, wrong keyword identity XPST0017 and forward references XPST0008.
ownership: Original bytes and public descriptor code are unchanged. Expression edits change only the value span. Repeated validation and namespace-document refusal make no additional resolver requests; successful compilation retains the caller-controlled resolver.
publicApi: No public members or gate membership changes; explicit namespace-map parameter and binding predicate are internal.
boundaries: Named-template/function/mode/key and other component QName paths under local versions require separate audits; next: named templates.
Optional/default function execution, broader keyword/package linkage, named-type edit compilation and pattern/AVT edit support remain separate.
upstream: All 17 contributed cases were accepted in PRs #22-27; independent execution confirmation remains pending. No native cases or assertions changed in this slice.
